s2_definition: Substrate-authored, supervised. The substrate now proposes and implements changes via its own propose-spec / verify-merge-candidate pipeline. The operator role transforms from feature author to anchor maintainer (rotating anchors when justified, reviewing H5 baselines) and adversarial tester (introducing probes, hostile peers, untrusted external sources). New specs are authored by the substrate; the operator reviews and approves.
s2_operator_responsibilities: Rotate anchors (shared secrets) on a scheduled cadence or when compromise is suspected
Review substrate-authored specs before merge — verify alignment with IAL principles
Act as adversarial tester: introduce probes, attempt scope violations, test refusal paths
Monitor for interventionRefused impulses (S3 readiness signal)
Maintain lift-status.json as the canonical phase record
